subject: [hw] V17 start: VFP scalar class
body: V17 (VFP, both instruction sets) starting. Read PLAN, TASK, FACTS, n2a32.h, board. I will implement emu/n2a32_vfp.c + emu/n2a32_fp_util.h + emu/test_v17/** only. Plan: VFP load/store (VLDR/VSTR/VPUSH/VPOP/VLDM/VSTM incl. fldmiax/fstmiax odd-imm8 forms), VMOV core<->S/D incl. two-core and scalar lanes, VDUP from core (cp10 space, per V20 request), VMRS/VMSR FPSCR, all VADD..VFNMS, VABS/VNEG/VSQRT/VCMP(E), VCVT single<->double, int<->float, fixed, half VCVTB/VCVTT, ARMv8 VSEL/VMAXNM/VMINNM/VRINT{A,N,P,M,X,Z,R}/VCVT{A,N,P,M}. Host tests via llvm-mc encodings + 200000-word sweep under ASan/UBSan. No phone.
